title: PRAY THIS MORNING PRAYER BEFORE 9AM AND RECEIVE UNEXPECTED MIRACLES

Before you do anything this morning, before your phone, before your notifications, before your schedule, there is a God who is reaching for you and he's not reaching for you because you are perfect. But I want you to know something before I go any further. The fact that you are here is already a sign that God has not abandoned your case. The devil would have wanted you sleeping. Now look at what David understood that most believers in this generation have abandoned. He said morning. He listed morning. Not afternoon first, not evening first, morning. Because the man who gives God his morning has structured his entire day under divine authority. The man who gives God his morning has told the kingdom of darkness, "Before you plot against me, my father already knows the plans. Before you set the traps, my father has already sent the angel." Glory be to God. I want to teach you something very quickly, and then we're going to pray like we have never prayed before. There is a principle in the spirit that governs the gate of a day. Every single day has a gate. Just like every city has a gate, every day has a gate. And the gate of a day opens at midnight, but it is most accessible and most responsive at the hour of the morning. The reason the enemy fights people's mornings is not a coincidence. The reason you feel heavy in the morning, the reason you feel lazy in the morning, the reason your bed feels most comfortable at exactly the time you should be talking to God, that is not a natural phenomenon. That is a strategic spiritual agenda to keep you from accessing the gate of your day under divine blessing. Come on, somebody receive this.
